text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed near the outdoor 
stage, I caught sight of Narita Taisin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I figured nobody would be using this 
place at this hour... but what's with all 
these cardboard boxes?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's a brand new yoga mat in here. 
...Nice. It's gift-wrapped, though... Did 
you win it as a prize or something?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Taishin! You're helping clean up 
too!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about the tear-down work. They 
held an event here the other day, right? 
It's clearing away the stage sets, prizes, 
and everything from back then.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Prez and the others have their 
hands full~ So I'm gonna solve it for 
them!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They said once we finish cleaning up, we 
can keep the leftover prizes! It's a 
treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'll help too. Cleaning up.
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll help out too.
Well then, I'll help out too.

text_block_list.text:
And so began the stage teardown. Since I 
was there, I joined in to help clean up 
together, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, no matter how much I carry, it 
never ends! Nobody told me it was gonna be 
this tough~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I underestimated this a bit... Why on 
earth did they build such a massive 
set...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa?! Out of the way, out of the 
waaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? W-Wait, look out—!
(CRRRASHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, finally done...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I knocked a bunch of things over along the 
way, but I somehow managed to see it 
through!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, true. Then I'll take this yoga mat 
and—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Umm... You know, it's not over just yet... 
Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry! The backstage area is still left, 
actually! I wanted to help the Prez, so I 
accidentally blurted out that I'd clean up 
the whole thing!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously saying that...? Just 
getting here was already exhausting 
enough...
choice_data_list: I'll help you all the way to the end.

Let's think of a more efficient way to do 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Dammit, let's get this over with 
already.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*~... *pant*~... *gasp*~... 
Turbo... at... full... throttle~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Full throttle? More like staggering on 
your feet... You've got terrible stamina 
pacing. Why don't you rest a bit?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fuhi... A-Alright, I'll rest just a little 
bit...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teio, make sure you take down the set 
carefully too. It'll be bad if something 
collapses and someone gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you might be right. Thanks, 
Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Even so, this is some serious hard 
labor.
choice_data_list:
Still, you're sticking with them to the 
very end.

Still, you're sticking with them to the 
very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. I'm just doing this for the 
reward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Come on, stop talking and get to it.

And so, though it took some time, Narita 
Taishin somehow managed to finish tidying 
up. She successfully claimed her desired 
reward, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's a limit to efficiency, you know... 
We've spent this much time on just one 
spot.
choice_data_list: Let's think of it like a quest in a game.

text_block_list.text:
Using a game as an analogy, I advised her 
to think about how she would arrange her 
party members.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... A quest, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teio's nimble, so maybe technical work. 
Like taking down the sets or packing up 
equipment— something that needs a delicate 
touch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's, well, fast on her feet, so maybe 
like a foot soldier? Focus mainly on 
carrying stuff.
choice_data_list: By the way, what about me?
By the way, what about me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Villager.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So you're on general chore duty. Come on, 
get a move on.

And so, under Narita Taishin's 
instructions, we somehow finished cleaning 
up, and I successfully handed her the yoga 
mat reward.
